ICS 13.060.25CHD 13Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis code deals with the chemical methods of attaining the conditions to be aimed at, in the water side of boilers operating at pressures above 5.9 MN/m2 (60 kg/cm2) at the drum and for once-through type boilers.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, which constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publications, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged toinvestigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below:IS 3025 (Part 39) : 2021 Methods of sampling and test physical and chemical for water and wastewater: Part 39 Oil and grease (second revision)IS 10496 : 1983 Specification boiler water for feedwater, and condensate for pressure boilers
